mapper.select:
select qb.qc_status as type, count(0) as count from qc_info qb
qb.is_deleted = false and qb.qc_date is not null
and qb.qc_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
${params.param}
group by qb.qc_status

select case when #{params.type} = 'day' then to_char(qb.qc_date::DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') when #{params.type} = 'week' then to_char(qb.qc_date::DATE-(extract(dow from qb.qc_date::TIMESTAMP)-1||'day')::interval,'YYYY-mm-dd') when #{params.type} = 'month' then to_char(qb.qc_date::DATE, 'YYYY-MM') else '' end as dateStr, qb.qc_status as status, count (0) as count from qc_info qb
qb.is_deleted = false and qb.qc_date is not null
and qb.qc_date >= #{beginDate} and (#{endDate}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
${params.param}
group by dateStr, qb.qc_status order by dateStr asc

select case when qb.qc_user_name = '' then '尚未分配' else qb.qc_user_name end as qcUserName, count(0) as qcTotalQty, sum (case when qb.qc_status = 'finishQc' then 1 else 0 end) as qcFinishQty, sum (case when qb.qc_status = 'waitQc' then 1 else 0 end) as qcWaitQty, sum (case when qb.qc_status = 'exemption' then 1 else 0 end) as qcFreeQty, sum (case when wr.approve_time::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 DAY' >= qb.qc_finish_time then 1 else 0 end) as qcTimelyQty, sum (case when qb.qc_finish_time > wr.approve_time::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 DAY' and qb.qc_status in ('finishQc','exemption') then 1 else 0 end) as qcTimeOutQty, sum (case when now() > wr.approve_time::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 DAY' and qb.qc_status = 'waitQc' then 1 else 0 end) as unQcTimeOutQty from qc_info qb left join po_receive wr on qb.source_id = wr.id and wr.is_deleted = false
qb.is_deleted = false and qb.qc_date is not null
and qb.qc_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
${params.param}
group by qb.qc_user_id,qc_user_name

select qb.id as qcId, qb.source_id as sourceId, qb.qc_date as qcDate, qb.qc_user_name as qcUserName, qb.code as qcCode, qb.purchase_order_code as purchaseOrderCode, qp.sku_id as skuId, qp.sku_no as skuNo, qi.qc_qty as qcQty, qb.qc_status as qcStatus, qb.qc_finish_time as qcEndTime from qc_info qb inner join qc_result qi on qb.id = qi.main_id and qi.is_deleted = false inner join qc_product qp on qb.id = qp.main_id and qp.is_deleted = false left join po_receive wr on qb.source_id = wr.id and wr.is_deleted = false
qb.is_deleted = false and qb.qc_date is not null
and qb.qc_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
and qb.qc_status in
#{item}
and wr.approve_time::timestamp + '1 day' >= qb.qc_finish_time::timestamp
and (qb.qc_finish_time::timestamp > wr.approve_time::timestamp + '1 day' or (now() > wr.approve_time::timestamp + '1 day' and qb.qc_status = 'waitQc'))
${params.param}

select qb.id as qcId, qb.source_id as sourceId, qb.qc_date as qcDate, qb.qc_user_name as qcUserName, qb.code as qcCode, qb.purchase_order_code as purchaseOrderCode, qp.sku_id as skuId, qp.sku_no as skuNo, qi.qc_qty as qcQty, qb.qc_status as qcStatus, qb.qc_finish_time as qcEndTime from qc_info qb inner join qc_result qi on qb.id = qi.main_id and qi.is_deleted = false inner join qc_product qp on qb.id = qp.main_id and qp.is_deleted = false left join po_receive wr on qb.source_id = wr.id and wr.is_deleted = false
qb.is_deleted = false and qb.qc_date is not null
and qb.qc_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > qb.qc_date
and qb.qc_status in
#{item}
and wr.approve_time::timestamp + '1 day' >= qb.qc_finish_time::timestamp
and (qb.qc_finish_time::timestamp > wr.approve_time::timestamp + '1 day' or (now() > wr.approve_time::timestamp + '1 day' and qb.qc_status = 'waitQc'))
${params.param}

select qi.code, qi.qc_dept_id, qi.qc_dept_name, qi.qc_user_id, qi.qc_user_name, qi.purchase_order_id, qi.purchase_order_code, qi.qc_status, qi.qc_date, qi.qc_finish_time, qi.source_type, qi.source_id, qi.supplier_id, qi.warehouse_id from qc_info qi left join qc_result qr on qi.id = qr.main_id and qr.is_deleted = false where qi.is_deleted and qr.purchase_order_detail_id in
#{item}
